Work with Cataract and Vitreoretinal R&D groups on development projects resulting in achieving R&D's project goals. Tasks include supplier evaluation/qualification, component qualification, managing prototype builds, assuring assembly process is developed and documented, assure BOM's are entered and maintained correctly, assure product costs are accurate and rolled, conduct Production Readiness Review.
Support Product transfer projects either into or out of plant.
Identify and qualify alternate materials and/or components for either risk mitigation or because of obsolescence.
Maintain adequate supply of purchased components through contact with Procurement and the Suppliers. Qualify tooling and equipment as required to assure capacity.
Address any component or product quality issue assigned, determining root cause and completing corrective action.
Address any requests from other departments related to BOM's and components.
Manage product labeling.
Identify and qualify Cost Improvements.
cond_0111.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 1–3 years of experience in an engineering or scientific R&D or manufacturing environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Master's degree in an engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Familiarity with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.
Some background in writing technical protocols or reports.
Ability to communicate clearly in spoken and written English.
Willingness to work collaboratively with others.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in the Medical Device industry in Manufacturing, Design, or Quality Engineering.
Exposure to root cause analysis methods for identifying the cause of issues.
Experience in the range of 3–10 years in an engineering or scientific environment.
Comfort taking initiative and showing leadership in day-to-day work.
Ability to learn and retain complex processes over time.
Attention to detail and a focus on quality.

Work with Cataract and Vitreoretinal R&D groups on development projects resulting in achieving R&D's project goals. Tasks include supplier evaluation/qualification, component qualification, managing prototype builds, assuring assembly process is developed and documented, assure BOM's are entered and maintained correctly, assure product costs are accurate and rolled, conduct Production Readiness Review.
Support Product transfer projects either into or out of plant.
Identify and qualify alternate materials and/or components for either risk mitigation or because of obsolescence.
Maintain adequate supply of purchased components through contact with Procurement and the Suppliers. Qualify tooling and equipment as required to assure capacity.
Address any component or product quality issue assigned, determining root cause and completing corrective action.
Address any requests from other departments related to BOM's and components.
Manage product labeling.
Identify and qualify Cost Improvements.
cond_0293.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Communicates clearly.
Speaks/writes English.
Works well with others.
Has leadership capability and is a self starter.
Focuses on detail/quality.
Experience writing technical protocols/reports.
Ability to use MS Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Project.
Root cause analysis experience to determining cause of issues.
Masters in engineering or scientific discipline.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to learn and retain many complex processes quickly.
Experience in Medical Device industry - Manufacturing / Design / Quality Engineering fields.
1-10 Years experience in an engineering or scientific R&D or manufacturing environment.

Work with Cataract and Vitreoretinal R&D groups on development projects resulting in achieving R&D's project goals. Tasks include supplier evaluation/qualification, component qualification, managing prototype builds, assuring assembly process is developed and documented, assure BOM's are entered and maintained correctly, assure product costs are accurate and rolled, conduct Production Readiness Review.
Support Product transfer projects either into or out of plant.
Identify and qualify alternate materials and/or components for either risk mitigation or because of obsolescence.
Maintain adequate supply of purchased components through contact with Procurement and the Suppliers. Qualify tooling and equipment as required to assure capacity.
Address any component or product quality issue assigned, determining root cause and completing corrective action.
Address any requests from other departments related to BOM's and components.
Manage product labeling.
Identify and qualify Cost Improvements.
cond_0470.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's degree in engineering or a scientific discipline required; advanced degree (e.g., PhD) strongly preferred.
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise in an engineering or scientific R&D or manufacturing environment.
Proven track record in the Medical Device industry across Manufacturing, Design, or Quality Engineering.
Deep knowledge of root cause analysis methodologies for identifying and resolving technical issues.
Extensive experience writing technical protocols and reports.
Strong command of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.
Preferred Requirements
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with full professional proficiency in English.
Strong leadership abilities and demonstrated capacity to work independently without close direction.
Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
Advanced ability to learn and retain complex processes with a high degree of accuracy.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
